changes: Use 256 threads / eight body warps per job, instead of 128 threads / four warps.
Load each body's triangular factor cooperatively into per-warp shared memory before serial triangular substitutions.
Preserve equation summation order, projection, convergence tests, solver tolerances, physics profiles and public API.
selection: 256 threads is retained: 512 was faster at rollout batch 32 but slower than 256 at batch 128. Shared-factor caching at 128 threads was a smaller gain. No runtime tuning option added.

method.rollouts: Recorded 22-stone scene; all stones dynamic; independent identical scene copies; 100 timesteps; 3D and 4D contacts; batches 32/128; one cold + two warm runs; warm median shown.
method.mcts: 49 stones, nine already placed, seed 0, current CUDA profile requesting 512 iterations, evaluation/native batch 32, four result workers. No config overrides.
method.timing: Sequential processes with OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1. Full native rollout timing includes host staging, transfers, physics and result construction; fingerprints computed outside timing.
method.install: Editable stacking-core rebuilt with CUDA in the existing project environment; final MCTS run uses the normal interpreter without PYTHONPATH.
limitations: Single-seed MCTS check; identical-scene rollout batches are not search workloads.
Hardware-counter profiling was unavailable under the current restricted driver setting; conclusions use timing, the preceding Nsight Systems trace, and exact result comparisons.
Before/after MCTS comparisons match tree/CEM statistics and the selected result, not a bytewise serialization of every internal tree state.

scene.simulation_profile_yaml:
# Independently resolved excavator SI profile; see docs/excavator-planning.md.
units: si
integration:
  dt: 0.01
  gravity: [0.0, 0.0, -9.81]
  damping: 0.0
ground:
  z: 0.0
  friction: 5.0
scene:
  frame_id: 1
physics:
  settling:
    contact:
      model: single_point
      error_reduction_ratio: 0.2
      detection_margin: 0.01
    solver:
      constraint_scale_reference: 0.001
      beta_init: 0.1
      beta_update_interval: 50
      max_iters: 2000
      stagnation_window: 0
      tol_abs: 0.001
      tol_rel: 0.0001
  structural:
    contact:
      model: limit_surface_4d
      error_reduction_ratio: 0.2
      detection_margin: 0.01
    solver:
      constraint_scale_reference: 0.001
      beta_init: 0.1
      beta_update_interval: 50
      max_iters: 2000
      stagnation_window: 0
      tol_abs: 0.0001
      tol_rel: 1.0e-05
phases:
  settling:
    dt: 0.01
    steps: 400
    sample_count: 64
  short_structural:
    energy_threshold: 0.00001
    velocity_integral_threshold: 0.2
    min_time: 0.5
    max_time: 4.0
    extra_steps: 20
    final_extra_steps: 40
    freeze_radius: 1.5
  structural:
    energy_threshold: 0.00001
    velocity_integral_threshold: 0.2
    min_time: 3.0
    max_time: 15.0
    extra_steps: 150
    final_extra_steps: 300
validation:
  contact_gap_tolerance: 0.02
  minimum_support_count: 1
  support_chain_z_tolerance: 0.05

baseline.scope:
Time CUDA rollouts and fingerprint states while tuning simulation kernels.

The first call for each model/batch is cold; subsequent calls reuse the simulator.
Fingerprinting is outside the timed region. All batch slots repeat one scene.

before.note: Search-only wall timers; inclusive values overlap. CPU worker times sum overlapping threads and are not search wall time. Exclusive values subtract instrumented child calls on the same thread; native calls include immediate return handling, not pure kernel time.
